scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:png && bun run build:svg && echo '✓ built png in ./out and svg in ./out-svg'
scripts.build:png: echo '→ rendering PNG via likec4 (Playwright)' && likec4 export png -o ./out
scripts.build:svg: echo '→ generating D2 sources + rendering SVG' && likec4 gen d2 -o ./d2 && bun run render:svg
scripts.render:svg: mkdir -p ./out-svg && for f in ./d2/*.d2; do name=$(basename "$f" .d2); d2 --layout elk --theme 300 "$f" "./out-svg/${name}.svg"; done
